newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium to join Geneva meeting on Kivu crisis.
newsitem.headline: Belgium to join Geneva meeting on Kivu crisis.

text.p: Belgian State Secretary for Cooperation and Development Reginald Moreels was travelling to Geneva on Tuesday evening for urgent talks with French and other officials on the situation in eastern Zaire, his office said.

Moreels will attend a meeting called by his French counterpart Xavier Emmannuelli, other representatives from European Union member states and officials from the Red Cross, the office of the High Commissioner for Refugees and the United Nations World Food Programme.
The meeting aims to examine how the humanitarian needs of an estimated 500,000 refugees in the Kivu area can be met.

Zairean troops and ethnic Tutsi rebels have been fighting a spreading war over the past 10 days, causing thousands of Burundian and Rwandan refugees to leave their camps and natives to leave their villages.
Up to 400,000 Rwandan Hutus are currently cut off in the north of the Goma region and 300,000 are on the run in Uvira and Bukavu further south.
